scope: Bounded review of all nine Australian electoral commission hubs and targeted election/vacancy leads. This is not an exhaustive review of every council, parliamentary vacancy, candidate, result or profile.
method: Official pages were read directly where available. Fresh ordinary origin HTTP responses, web-source crawl freshness, older copies and access failures are distinguished. Only confirmed Milngin changes are proposed; unrelated canonical facts and check dates retain their evidence.

receipts.scope: Milngin Ward: NTEC confirms a contested supplementary by-election with two candidates for one vacancy. The current timetable gives early voting from 30 November at 8:30 am, while mobile voting and postal mail-out remain on 23 November. Postal dispatch labels and the candidate-name spelling discrepancy remain attributed; prior timezone and separate deadline evidence is retained.
receipts.liveVerification: The recorded exact-commit Pages and CI checks succeeded, followed by ordinary live HTTP file verification for the enumerated verifiedPaths. This receipt records that bounded delivery verification.

findings: Current official hubs retain 3 December postal elections for Carnarvon contested offices, Coolgardie and Esperance Town. Latest listed media release remains 17 November. It repeats 6 pm 3 December receipt and advises early posting, while allowing hand-return to the local government office in the reply-paid envelope. Existing records correctly describe a receipt deadline and do not prohibit hand delivery. This is useful routine guidance, not a deadline or candidate correction.
